name: fleet-delivery
description: Delivers a seat's Room inbox and pending job results into the session through the prompt API, one prompt per item, recorded in an on-disk ledger per seat. Inert until <installRoot>/.aigent/delivery-owner.json says {"owner":{"<seat>":"mod"}}.

installRoot.title: Install root
installRoot.description: Folder holding .aigent/delivery-owner.json, memory/runtime/mod-delivery-ledger.<seat>.jsonl and daemons/job-results.mjs. Empty: the mod does nothing.

roomRoot.title: Room root
roomRoot.description: The Room's room/ folder; the seat's inbox is <roomRoot>/inbox/<seat>/. Empty: Room delivery is off.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: Seat name whose inbox is delivered. Empty: env SEAT, else the session root's folder name. Must match [a-z0-9_-]+, else the mod does nothing.

jobSeat.title: Job results seat
jobSeat.description: The one seat job results are delivered to (job records carry no recipient). Empty: job delivery is off.

submitTimeoutMinutes.title: Submit timeout (minutes)
submitTimeoutMinutes.description: How long a submit may wait for its turn to start before it is recorded deferred:submit-timeout.
